assumptions.choice: Synthesize daily and 4-hour OHLCV bars manually inside the strategy by aggregating the single 1h feed (daily bar closes on calendar-date rollover; 4h bar = 4 consecutive hourly bars, resetting each trading day so the day yields one 4-bar candle plus one shorter trailing candle).
assumptions.reason: The harness supplies exactly one bt.feeds.PandasData of 1h bars with cerebro wiring fixed by the harness, so true resampled daily/4h feeds are unavailable; this is the closest literal, causal (no-lookahead) reconstruction of the two timeframes the spec requires.

assumptions.choice: A daily local low/high is a bar whose low/high is the min/max within a symmetric +/-1-day window, confirmed with a 1-day lag. First confirmed low = left shoulder; a subsequent lower low = head; a later higher low within tolerance of the left-shoulder low = right shoulder. Neckline = the line through the highest daily high between left-shoulder<->head and head<->right-shoulder, extrapolated forward via its slope.
assumptions.reason: The spec describes the pattern qualitatively with no precise swing-detection, tolerance, or neckline-slope definition, so a concrete deterministic causal rule was required to make the pattern machine-checkable.
Spec says shoulders must be at 'approximately the same level' without giving a number.

assumptions.choice: 0.5% below the lower of the head's low and the right shoulder's low.
assumptions.reason: Spec says the stop is placed 'a few points below' the head/last local low without a number.

assumptions.choice: 1% of current portfolio value (broker.getvalue()), used with (entry close - stop price) to size the position via self.buy(size=...).
assumptions.reason: Spec gives a 1-2% range rather than a single value; the lower bound was chosen as a conservative default.

assumptions.choice: Daily SMA20 is 'sloping downward' when today's SMA20 value is less than the prior day's SMA20 value.
assumptions.reason: Spec says the SMA must not be sloping downward but does not specify the lookback used to measure slope.

assumptions.choice: Implemented the close-below-neckline exit (using the same live/extrapolated neckline) even though the spec labels it 'optional', since it is one of the three explicitly enumerated exit conditions.
assumptions.reason: Faithfulness to every stated rule per the assignment's instructions.
